title: Google ad
description: One record per Google ad (creative) from the Google Ads Transparency Center. Every key is present on every record and no value is ever null: empty strings, empty arrays and 0 stand for 'none'. In monitor mode the dataset holds only ads Google first showed since the previous run for that target.

target.title: Target
target.description: The input line this ad was found for, exactly as given (domain, advertiser ID or Transparency Center URL).

targetType.title: Target type
targetType.description: 'domain': a landing-domain search, which also finds resellers and agencies advertising that domain. 'advertiser': one advertiser account.

region.title: Region filter
region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the listing was filtered to, or 'anywhere'.

advertiserId.title: Advertiser ID
advertiserId.description: Google Ads advertiser ID (starts with AR). Stable; use it to filter a domain search down to one advertiser.

advertiserName.title: Advertiser
advertiserName.description: Verified legal name of the advertiser as shown by Google.

creativeId.title: Creative ID
creativeId.description: Google's ID of this ad (starts with CR). Stable across days; the unique key of a record.

adUrl.title: Ad page
adUrl.description: Link to this ad on the Google Ads Transparency Center.

format.title: Format
format.description: TEXT (search ads), IMAGE (display banners) or VIDEO (YouTube). UNKNOWN for a format Google has not been seen to use.

landingDomain.title: Landing domain
landingDomain.description: Domain the ad sends people to: the searched domain for domain targets; for advertiser targets, taken from the landing URL or else the display URL. Empty when the ad shows neither.

firstShown.title: First shown
firstShown.description: ISO 8601 time Google first showed the ad. Monitor mode uses this, not 'first time we saw it', to decide what is new.

lastShown.title: Last shown
lastShown.description: ISO 8601 time Google last showed the ad. Recent means still running.

daysServed.title: Days served
daysServed.description: Number of days Google has served the ad.

regions.title: Served in
regions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries the ad was served in.

variations.title: Variations
variations.description: Number of variations Google keeps for this ad (asset combinations).

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Ad headline. Text ads: read from Google's archived screenshot (OCR). Video and image ads: from the ad's own data; for app-install ads, the app name. Empty when the ad has no readable text.
examples: HubSpot for Startups - Bootstrap to Series A

description.title: Description
description.description: Ad description (body text), same sources as headline. Empty when none.
examples: Partnered with top VCs and accelerators. Get exclusive startup pricing and resources. From...

displayUrl.title: Display URL
displayUrl.description: URL as printed on the ad (not necessarily where it lands).

landingUrl.title: Landing URL
landingUrl.description: Full click-through URL from the ad's own data (video and some image ads; app store listing for app-install ads). Empty for text ads read from a screenshot.

callToAction.title: Call to action
callToAction.description: Button text of video and image ads, in the ad's language. Empty when none.

videoUrl.title: Video
videoUrl.description: YouTube link of a video ad. Empty for other formats.

copySource.title: Copy source
copySource.description: Where headline/description came from: 'ocr' (text read from the archived screenshot), 'contentjs' (the ad's own data), or 'none' (no copy available).

copyLanguage.title: OCR language
copyLanguage.description: Tesseract language pack that read the copy (e.g. 'eng', 'jpn+eng'); empty when copy did not come from OCR.

previewImageUrl.title: Preview image
previewImageUrl.description: URL of Google's archived screenshot of the ad, when it has one.

previewScriptUrl.title: Preview script
previewScriptUrl.description: URL of Google's interactive preview of the ad (content.js), when it has one.

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: ISO 8601 time this target was checked in this run.
